messages:
maria_g: Hey team — I noticed an out-of-network charge for a teletherapy session with BrightPath Therapy on 2026-03-12. Provider invoiced me $160 but my insurer portal only shows nothing under claims. Anyone walked through reimbursement for telehealth OON before?

emma_peopleops: @maria_g sorry to hear that. Quick Q — which plan do you have (PPO/HMO)? For PPOs you can usually self-submit for OON reimbursement.

maria_g: Redwood Standard PPO. I don’t see an EOB yet, only the provider invoice and the CC charge. Provider gave me an invoice but said insurer often needs claim form. Claim/reference from provider is in their system:
```
ProviderRef: 2026-03-BPT-459
Date: 2026-03-12
Amount: $160
Service: 50 min teletherapy
```

ben_benefits: For PPO here's the usual flow (short):
1) Get itemized receipt/invoice from provider (you have it).
2) Wait for EOB from insurer (sometimes posts 1-2 weeks after claim).
3) If EOB doesn't appear, submit out-of-network claim via insurer member portal or email claims — attach provider invoice + any clinical notes if requested.
4) Expect partial reimbursement (usually allowed amount * coverage percent). Keep copies for taxes.

Also note: some carriers accept "proof of payment" + invoice if EOB delayed. If they ask for CPT code ask provider to include it (e.g., 90834 or similar).

maria_g: Helpful, thanks. Provider mentioned "prior auth" for continuing weekly sessions. Do we need that for teletherapy?

ben_benefits: Usually outpatient therapy doesn't require prior auth for short-term care, but it depends — some plans need prior auth after a threshold (e.g., 20 sessions) or for certain modalities. Provider should submit prior auth through their provider portal. If they ask for member info, give them your member ID (on card). If you prefer, we can reach out to insurer and confirm.

emma_peopleops: If you'd like Redwood to assist, DM me the redacted invoice and I’ll open a case with the carrier and ask about EOB timing + prior auth requirements. Also FYI Redwood offers EAP (short-term counseling) that might cover initial sessions while auth/claims sort out: https://portal.redwoodhealth/eap :slightly_smiling_face:

ryan_finance: If you want an advance reimbursement while claims are pending, Finance can do a one-off payout if you submit expense in Expensify/Concur with the invoice and short note. Ping me and I’ll route approval. :+1:

maria_g: Great — I’ll DM @emma_peopleops the invoice (redacted SSN) and upload to insurer portal. Last Q — my physical insurance card is lost. Can I get a digital ID to give the provider?

ben_benefits: Yes — log into the member portal > ID cards > download PDF or save mobile card. If portal is acting up, tell me and I can request a replacement card or attach a PDF for you to share with provider.

benefits_bot: [automated] Carrier FAQ: Out-of-network telehealth reimbursement timelines vary by carrier — allow up to 30 days for claims processing. Helpful links: https://redwood.benefits/ppo-summary and carrier claims upload page: https://carrier.example/claims-upload

maria_g: Thanks everyone — will DM the invoice to @emma_peopleops and try the portal. Will update here if carrier responds or if I need an advance. :pray:
